sections.Profile:
The "Boston" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in 1949, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: America, United States, Single Player, Travel, Wood Rail, City, Original Theme, History
